summary: Public projects created on 30 July 2026: 9 repos.
intro: Agent plugins for Claude Code covered Israeli business opening hours, vendor support contacts, freight volume arithmetic, Brother P-touch label printing, and Israeli subscription cancellations. Documentation work described an orchestration agent briefing model and a curated index of open-source logistics and supply chain projects, alongside Android driving checklists.
